entities.name: Yūsuke Ōyama
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yūsuke Ōyama  is a Japanese professional baseball infielder for the Hanshin Tigers of Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB). As a player, he has made the All-Star team three times, won the Best Nine Award twice and helped his team win the 2023 Japan Series.
